rows.note: Sampler-side token-selection priority over the tool-call span (same prompt, model, tool schema and executor); launches on the sampler's `tool_call_ready` readiness signal. Speculative: the span can settle to a call the final program does not contain, so false launches and wasted work are counted for this row too. Labelled P-ReAct-*style*: our priority is a fixed entropy-threshold relaxation, not a learned guidance signal. See docs/baselines.md D.
